checkpoints.question: A second publisher starts with `__node:=talker_two`. Why is it easier to inspect, and which topic does it publish to in this activity?
checkpoints.model_answer: Its distinct node name lets node-specific tools identify the instance unambiguously. It still publishes to `/chatter` because the relative topic name and root namespace remain unchanged.

evidence.label: Give a second publisher a distinct node name

checkpoints.question: Why did the listener remain quiet when only the publisher received `chatter:=greeting`, and why did restarting the listener with the same rule restore delivery?
checkpoints.model_answer: The publisher used `/greeting` while the listener still subscribed to `/chatter`. Applying the rule to the listener made both endpoints use `/greeting`; their message types and delivery settings were already compatible.

evidence.label: Remap both ends of a topic
